responsibility: Declares the public API and control structures for tree/GIMPLE body copying and inlining. It defines copy_body_data and its remapping/callgraph/EH/debug controls, the copy_body_cge_which policy enum, inlining cost weights, and prototypes for remapping declarations and types, copying bodies or GIMPLE sequences, expression inlining, insn estimation, and helper routines used by the inliner, cloning, versioning, and nested-function lowering.
same_name_distinction: Defines the public interface and configuration data for body copying, especially copy_body_data, policy enums, and exported helpers. Unlike gcc/tree-inline.cc, it describes how callers control inlining/body duplication rather than implementing the remapping and copy logic.
